name: Connect Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Connect Ventures (connectventures.co; LinkedIn /company/connect-ventures), the London pre-seed and seed VC run by Pietro Bezza, Sitar Teli and Rory Stirling. The site footer names Connect Ventures LLP (England and Wales OC367566, FCA 582584). Founded in 2012 by Pietro Bezza and Bill Earner (TechCrunch, FrenchWeb, May 2012). Not the US consumer-AI fund also called 'Connect Ventures' at connectventures.com (in partnership with Creative Artists Agency), a different firm whose deals are excluded here.

thesis_text.value: London partner-only firm that leads pre-seed (and some seed) rounds across Europe, backing technical founders from day zero. Fund V narrows the focus to companies where technology is core to the product, from AI and infrastructure to hardware, robotics, automation and biotech, with a low-volume, high-conviction, high-support model and $500k-$5m cheques.

open_items: application_url: none found. The site has no pitch form or contact page (/contact, /pitch, /apply, /founders and /about return 404), and the homepage has no mailto link. accepts_cold_inbound is therefore 'unknown'. The team includes a 'Dealflow Ops Analyst', but no inbound process is stated.
requires_us_entity: not stated, so recorded as 'unknown'. The stated geography is Europe only, and the portfolio spans BE, DE, FR, IT, NL, SE, CH and the UK (plus one US-tagged company).
Indian founders: nothing stated, so the fact is omitted.
Fund II ('Connect Ventures Two'): only a database listing (EUACC) was found, with no size, vintage or close date. The firm's Fund III post does not size it.
Fund I: only the €16M first close (target €43M) of May 2012 was found; the final size is unknown. FrenchWeb says Fund I targeted early-stage startups in London, Berlin, Stockholm and Tel Aviv.

Fund IV: the post (5 Sep 2023) says 'at $80M' but does not say whether that is a final close. Search results show British Patient Capital commitments (a cornerstone in Fund III and £20m in Fund IV), but the BBB and BPC pages returned 403, so they are not recorded.

Fund V: first close of $55M against an $80M target, anchored by British Business Bank, with returning LPs Aldea Ventures, Sella Venture Partners and Molten Ventures plus family offices and Connect-backed founders. The firm's post is undated, so the date comes from Tech.eu (23 Sep 2026). The user-list lead '2026 fund $55M first close' is confirmed.
Fund III LPs (firm post): Top Tier Capital Partners, Isomer Capital, British Patient Capital, Big Society Capital and De Agostini. Tech.eu also names Draper Esprit and Korelya Capital.

Rounds not recorded because no fetched round page names Connect, or because the page was blocked: Ogment pre-seed (Oct 2024; a Nordic9 search result names Connect with Eniac, Boost VC and Earthling VC, but the page returned 403); Molecular Glue Labs (Fund V post cites it as a recent techbio investment; no round article found); Unwritten and Neverless (2024); Embedd (2023, firmware hardware abstraction); Aikido seed co-led with Notion in late 2023 (2024 review); Dust $40M Series B (Connect's newsletter does not say it participated).

ai-coustics earlier round: Connect's homepage says 'Led the pre-seed in 2023', while TechCrunch (25 Mar 2024) reports €1.9M from Connect Ventures, Inovia Capital, FOV Ventures and Jan Bohl without naming a lead or stage. It is not recorded as a separate round.
Cino: Connect's post says it participated in the €3.5m seed but names no lead or co-investors.
Mosaico amount (€1M) comes from Connect's undated newsletter, 'New year, new unicorn' (Jan 2026). The Nordic9 article on the co-led Vento round returned 403.

Zellify date (28 Apr 2026) comes from Signalbase (a database). The Sifted article returned 403, and Connect's own investment post is undated (its 5 May 2026 newsletter welcomes Zellify). Seedtable, seen only in search results, lists Inovia as lead, which conflicts with Connect's and Zellify's own pages.
Dessn date is the date of Connect's post (12 May 2026); no press article was fetched. Nexcade and Ewake rest on Connect's own posts only; no press article was fetched.
Founding year was not found for Dessn, Zellify, Mosaico, Nexcade, Ewake, Cloud Capital, Steep, Tuza or Torg. Company HQ countries come from Connect's portfolio pages.

Partner focus sectors are inferred from the bios (Bezza: B2B software; Stirling: product-led fintech; Teli: consumer, marketplaces and networked SaaS) and from the deals each wrote up. Non-investing staff (CFO Mark Pettit, Head of Finance Amira Naik, Head of Marketing Claire Walker, Operations Manager Rosie Cipolla, Dealflow Ops Analyst Sai Tatireddy) are not recorded. Co-founder Bill Earner (2012) no longer appears on the site.
